# Optional VVVVVV assets (paths relative to data/).

# Not needed at runtime by this port:
#  - music/*.ogg is only read when the game is rebuilt with VVV_COMPILEMUSIC.

#  - mmmmmm.vvv is the alternate "MMMMMM" soundtrack pack.
